challenge.description: Muna shirya komai domin ku iya ci gaba.
challenge.details.body: Wannan ɗan dubawar na taimakawa gidan yanar gizon ya kasance a buɗe ga kowa. Burauzarku tana yin ɗan aikin lissafi don tabbatar da wannan ziyarar.
challenge.details.randomx: Dubawar da ke buƙatar ƙarin ƙarfin CPU ko ƙwaƙwalwar ajiya, kamar RandomX, tana neman izininku kafin ta fara. Kuna iya barin wannan shafin idan ba ku son ci gaba.
challenge.details.summary: Me ya sa nake ganin wannan shafin?
challenge.hashwx_unsupported: Wannan burauzar ba za ta iya gudanar da HashWX ba. Ana buƙatar goyon bayan WebAssembly da Web Workers.
challenge.javascript_required: Da fatan za a kunna JavaScript a burauzarku, sannan a sake loda wannan shafin.
challenge.load_error: Dubawar ta kasa farawa. Wataƙila haɗin yana jinkiri ko an toshe wani fayil.
challenge.randomx_unsupported: Wannan burauzar ba za ta iya gudanar da RandomX ba. Ana buƙatar burauzar da ke goyon bayan WebAssembly, BigInt da Web Workers.
challenge.state.blocked.description: Wataƙila ƙarin burauza ko matatar hanyar sadarwa ta toshe fayil ɗin da wannan dubawar ke buƙata. Ba da izinin wannan gidan yanar gizon a cikin ƙarin burauzar, sannan a sake gwadawa.
challenge.state.blocked.title: Wani abu ya toshe dubawar
challenge.state.connecting.description: Muna haɗawa da sabis na tabbatarwa.
challenge.state.connecting.title: Ana haɗawa
challenge.state.consent.description: Wannan dubawar tana amfani da ƙarin ƙarfin CPU da ƙwaƙwalwar ajiyar na'urarku. Za ta fara ne kawai idan kun amince ku ci gaba.
challenge.state.consent.title: Mataki ɗaya ya rage
challenge.state.cookies.description: Wannan shafin yana amfani da kuki don tuna cewa burauzarka ta wuce binciken. Ba da damar kukis ga wannan shafin, sannan ka sake gwadawa.
challenge.state.cookies.status: An kashe ko an toshe kukis.
challenge.state.cookies.title: An toshe kukis
challenge.state.expired.description: Dubawar ta ɗauki lokaci fiye da yadda aka zata. Sabuwar dubawa na iya taimakawa.
challenge.state.expired.title: Mu sake gwadawa
challenge.state.failed.description: Ba mu sami damar kammala dubawar a wannan karon ba. Wataƙila gwaji na gaba zai yi nasara.
challenge.state.failed.title: A sake gwadawa
challenge.state.fast.description: Burauzarku tana yin ɗan dubawa cikin sauri. Yawanci wannan yana kammala da kansa.
challenge.state.fast.title: A jira kaɗan
challenge.state.hashwx.description: Burauzarku tana yin ɗan dubawa cikin sauri. Mun gode da haƙurinku.

challenge.state.initializing.description: Muna saita dubawar a cikin burauzarku.
challenge.state.initializing.status: Wannan na iya ɗaukar ɗan lokaci…
challenge.state.initializing.title: Ana shiri
challenge.state.limited.description: Mun karɓi buƙatu da yawa. Jira kaɗan na iya taimakawa.
challenge.state.limited.title: A sake gwadawa daga baya
challenge.state.network.description: Ba mu iya tuntuɓar sabis ɗin tabbatarwa ba. Da fatan za a duba haɗin intanet ɗinku.

challenge.state.pool.description: Muna jiran sabis ɗin tabbatarwa ya tabbatar da sakamakon.

challenge.state.randomx.title: An kusa gamawa
challenge.state.success.description: Mun gode da haƙurinku. Yanzu za ku iya ci gaba.
challenge.state.success.title: Komai ya yi!
challenge.state.unavailable.description: Ba a samun sabis ɗin tabbatarwa a yanzu. Da fatan za a sake gwadawa nan ba da jimawa ba.
